dimensions.assessment: Affects coin collectors, buyers, and the National Fallen Firefighters Foundation through surcharge distributions.
dimensions.evidence: all surcharges received by the Secretary from the sale of coins issued under this Act shall be promptly paid by the Secretary to the National Fallen Firefighters Foundation

dimensions.assessment: Involves the production and sale of a limited number of commemorative numismatic coins.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of the Treasury shall mint and issue the following coins: (1) $5 gold coins... (2) $1 silver coins... (3) Half-dollar clad coins

dimensions.assessment: Requires the Treasury to recover all design and issuance costs so that the program results in no net cost to the federal government.
dimensions.evidence: minting and issuing coins under this Act will not result in any net cost to the United States Government

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes a single specific commemorative coin program for calendar year 2029.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may issue coins minted under this Act only during the 1-year period beginning on January 1, 2029

dimensions.assessment: Restricts coin issuance to a one-year window in 2029, though numismatic items remain legal tender permanently.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary may issue coins minted under this Act only during the 1-year period beginning on January 1, 2029

importance_detail.rationale: Directs the Secretary of the Treasury to mint and issue commemorative coins honoring firefighters and the National Fallen Firefighters Memorial, with surcharges supporting the National Fallen Firefighters Foundation.
